native_frame: X lateral, Y up, Z longitudinal, forward +Z; millimetres
luncosim_frame: Y-up, right-handed SI metres; CAD-to-USD unit scale 0.001
source_v4_frame_transform: The imported v4 body was Z-up; v5's root placement rotates the saved global model to Y-up. The saved world bounds and wheel centers below are measured after that root transform.
wheel_diameter_status: Published Venturi wheel-family value; Astrolab says FLIP uses the same full-size wheels as FLEX.
wheel_width_status: Study choice; exact FLIP/FLEX wheel width not published.
rim_recess_status: Image-informed study choice; the inner rim remains concentric and axially inset. It is not a measured flight offset/eccentric axle.
cable_routing_status: Count is public; 96-per-face distribution, 2 mm diameter and endpoint routing are visual-study choices.
spring_geometry_status: Count is published for wheel family; coil shape, wire size and placement are visual-only study choices; no compliance is simulated.
spoke_status: Tapered CAD study shape chosen from reference appearance; actual hub/spider drawing not public.
tire_status: Continuous smooth band is a render simplification; blade/elastomer stack and hyper-deformation not modeled.
panel_pose_status: Study presentation control only; public source says collapsible but does not publish joint type, axis, limits or dimensions.
panel_bounds_status: Study-choice backplate size; not an as-built panel specification.
panel_pose_in_global_frame: SolarArrayPanelBody is separate; panel rotates into positive Y in the saved Y-up global frame. 82 degrees is a presentation value, not the flight hinge angle.
cell_count_status: 80 visible graphic cells for appearance only; actual cell count, topology, active area and output are unpublished.
public_vehicle_mass_status: Venturi FLIP listing; exact mass-properties configuration, payload inclusion and CG/inertia are TBD.
launch_mass_status: LPSC 2026 #1874 says FLIP was limited to geometry and 480 kg launch mass originally designed for VIPER; this is distinct from 450 kg public rover mass.
maximum_payload_status: Public FLIP claim; individual payload allocation and interfaces TBD.
battery_pack_count_status: Venturi 2025 media kit; packs described as mounted behind solar panels.
battery_electrical_parameters_status: Voltage, usable Wh, discharge limits, pack masses and thermal limits are not disclosed for FLIP.
speed_status: Venturi FLIP listing; Venturi wheel page separately quotes 15 km/h for a generic rover. Not used as a drive controller limit.
